first_reported_timestamp.description: The timestamp of the first event that reported this condition.

latest_event.description: The latest notification event that was generated for the corresponding condition

severity.description: Severity of the condition, same as the event

info.description: The information from the notification event that was generated by the condition.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which this event was created

uuid.description: The uuid for this network enforcement node

org_id.description: The org id for this network enforcement node

hostname.description: The hostname for this network enforcement node

name.description: User friendly name for this network enforcement node

public_ip.description: Public ip of this network enforcement node

software_version.description: Network enforcement node software version string

last_status_at.description: The last time (rfc3339 timestamp) a status was received from this node

uptime_seconds.description: How long since the last restart of this service.

target_pce_fqdn.description: The FQDN of the PCE the Network Enforcement Node will use for future connections

active_pce_fqdn.description: The FQDN of the PCE that received the Network Enforcement Node's last heartbeat
